# Text effects (11)

Install: `npx shadcn@latest add @ballmac/<name>`. Import: `@/components/ballmac/<name>`. Names in parentheses are the exports.

- **gradient-text** (GradientText): Text filled with a gradient of theme colors that slowly drifts, or a shiny variant that sweeps a glint of light across it on a pause. Not for: Body text or long passages (contrast varies along the gradient).
- **highlighter** (Highlighter): Hand-drawn marks around inline text: highlight, underline, box, circle, strike-through and brackets, drawn in when the phrase scrolls into view. Not for: Multi-line passages.
- **hyper-text** (HyperText): Characters flip through random letters like a split-flap board and settle left to right, as plain text or on tiles, on load, on scroll or on hover and focus. Not for: Anything that must stay readable mid-animation.
- **match-highlight** (MatchHighlight, queryTokens, matchesAll, countMatches): Text with the words of a search marked, as search results show them: real mark elements in a theme tint that stays readable in light and dark, plus helpers that split a… Not for: Syntax highlighting of code (use code-block).
- **morphing-text** (MorphingText): Words melt into each other with a blur and threshold effect, cycling through a list, pausing when off screen, with a box that never jumps in width. Not for: Small body text (the effect needs large type).
- **scramble-text** (ScrambleText): Decodes text in place: each character cycles through random glyphs before settling, left to right. Not for: Paragraphs or anything longer than a line.
- **sparkles-text** (SparklesText): Text with four-point stars that twinkle around it in theme colors, re-rolling position each time, with an optional gradient fill. Not for: Dense UI.
- **spinning-text** (SpinningText): Text laid out on a circle that turns slowly, with a center slot for a logo or arrow, pausing on hover. Not for: Information people need to read (rotating text is hard to read).
- **text-animate** (TextAnimate): Reveals text by character, word or line with eight entrances (fade, blur, slide, scale, rotate), staggered and triggered on scroll, with the full text kept for screen… Not for: Paragraphs of body text.
- **typing-text** (TypingText): A typewriter that types and erases one or several strings with natural timing and a blinking caret, starting on scroll if you like, with the whole text available to… Not for: Streaming AI output (streaming-text).
- **word-rotate** (WordRotate): Cycles one word of a sentence with a vertical slide and blur while its width springs to the next word, so the rest of the line reflows smoothly. Not for: Information people must read in full (rotating text is easy to miss).
